scenicChapters.title: Jersey Highlands and Greenwood Lake fuel gate → Jersey Highlands and G
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 21 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
